_comment: PLACEHOLDER MANIFEST - a human finishes this before publishing to the Minds Bazaar. Fill the four PLACEHOLDER_* fields, confirm chainId/contract address, then submit the publish form. See agent-guide.md for behaviour.
publicId: PLACEHOLDER_PUBLIC_ID (assigned by the Minds Bazaar on publish, e.g. "skill_xxxxxxxxxxxx")
summary: Independently verify a PackProof NFT or a PSA cert number: PSA-registry match, authentication-report-hash check, provably-fair verifyReveal, and the on-chain provenance chain.
activationMessage: PLACEHOLDER_ACTIVATION_MESSAGE (shown to the user when the Mind equips this Skill, e.g. "I can independently verify any PackProof card or PSA cert. Send me a PackProof token id or a PSA cert number and I'll check authenticity, fairness, and provenance against the Mantle chain and PSA's registry.")

tokenId.description: A PackProof external-NFT or reward-NFT token id. One of tokenId or certNumber is required.

certNumber.description: A PSA certification number. Resolved to a PackProof token if one exists. One of tokenId or certNumber is required.

output.description: A VerifyResult: see the VerifyResult type in handler.ts. Carries an overall verdict plus per-check booleans (psaMatch, reportHashMatch, revealMatch) and the provenance chain.

network._comment: PLACEHOLDER - set to the deployed PackProof network. Mantle mainnet chainId 5000, Mantle Sepolia testnet chainId 5003.

permissions.writes: none — this Skill never sends a transaction or mutates state

publishChecklist: Set network.chainId to the deployed network.
Swap handler.ts createReader() from the mock reader to the live viem reader (USE_MOCK=false) and confirm the ABIs match the deployed contract.
Confirm PSA_REGISTRY_BASE_URL points at the attribution-compliant registry endpoint.
Smoke-test against a real tokenized cert, then submit the Bazaar publish form and capture name + ID.
